the_finding_that_outlasts_the_numbers: Three of this report's four headline comparisons are denominator changes wearing the clothes of results. global_avg 6.083 -> 6.091 looks like a gain and spans two different spines (24 sequences vs 22). Voice coverage 71% -> 75% looks like enrichment and is one museum row of 2,409 placements entering a placement-scoped average at 81% voiced. Release gates 8/8 PASS -> 9/11 FAIL looks like decline and is three harder gates being added while the passing count rose. In all three cases the honest reading is the opposite of, or orthogonal to, the arithmetic. The ledger's existing discipline -- name the denominator, re-measure rather than carry -- is what made all three legible, and it caught them only because someone checked the denominator BEFORE reading the delta. The generalisation: in this project a delta with an unnamed denominator is not weak evidence, it is no evidence, and the three instruments that produce the project's headline numbers all silently change denominator under ordinary work.
